principal_limits.source_observation: Maximum 2 cm toward the margin. The central section contains only cryptotephra.
principal_limits.handling: Use 2 cm as a conditional ceiling on representative local fallout if a sampled margin retained the primary fall without net thinning. The 730 m station locates the mire, and the exact marginal pit has no unique ID in the thickness report. The earlier compiler latitude was about 39 km too far south.

principal_limits.source_observation: Sharp, discontinuous 1 cm ash pockets near the dispersion margin.
principal_limits.handling: Treat 1 cm as a conditional ceiling on local background thickness if a retained pocket was at least as thick as the local original blanket. Loss from every pocket would invalidate the ceiling. Use omission or weaker retention in sensitivity.
